name: Tiwari Taxo Images
author: Brijesh Tiwari

sections.description:
Tiwari Taxo Images lets you add media fields to WordPress taxonomies with a clean interface. Supports Thumbnail images, multi-image Galleries, and SVG Icons.

Features:
– Separate standalone fields: Thumbnail Image, Image Gallery, and SVG Icon.
– Distinct table list columns for Image previews and SVG Icon previews.
– Deep integration for WooCommerce product categories and product tags.
– 7 native Gutenberg blocks with Inspector controls.
– 7 drag-and-drop Elementor widgets.
– Comprehensive shortcode library (combines galleries by lists or ‘all’ keyword).
– Developer helper APIs to query term media in templates.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate Tiwari Taxo Images
  3. Open Taxo Images from WordPress admin sidebar
  4. Toggle enabled settings for taxonomies and click Save
  5. Add/edit term media under Posts -> Categories or Products -> Categories
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Added separate standalone fields: Thumbnail, Gallery, and SVG Icon.
  • Added separate list table columns for Image and SVG Icon.
  • Added WooCommerce product taxonomy compatibility (init priority 20).
  • Added Gutenberg Blocks & Elementor Widgets support.
  • Updated Gallery shortcode to query combined media using comma-separated IDs or ‘all’ keyword.
  • Streamlined settings dashboard.

1.0.0

  • Initial release of Tiwari Taxo Images
